text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
............ The setting sun stings my 
eyes...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—...Hah!? When did I... surrender myself 
to the silence...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kh... ha ha ha! As if I would fall into 
the realm of nothingness!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Yet lost time can never be rewound. 
What a regrettable outcome...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet seems somewhat dazed. She 
might still be suffering from post-race 
fatigue. I should reconsider our race 
schedule.
